meta.titleEn: Are You Ready for the Climb?

questions.text: When the police arrived, they began to carefully check the crime scene and s_____ey the damage.
questions.translation: 當警察到達現場後，他們開始仔細檢查犯罪現場並調查損失情況。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
當警察到達現場後，他們開始仔細檢查犯罪現場並調查損失情況。這裡的「調查」指的是詳細了解或評估情況。
補充用法：
conduct a survey = 進行調查
survey the damage = 調查損失
survey the area = 調查區域

questions.text: Sean’s father became very worried as soon as he got the ur_____t message from his son.
questions.translation: Sean 的父親一收到他兒子的緊急訊息就變得非常擔心。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
Sean 的父親一收到他兒子的緊急訊息就變得非常擔心。這裡的「緊急」指的是需要立即處理的情況。
補充用法：
urgent message = 緊急訊息
urgent request = 緊急請求
urgent matter = 緊急事件

questions.text: The Japanese government e______ssed thanks to those who have helped them after the earthquake by filming a thank-you video.
questions.translation: 日本政府通過拍攝感謝視頻向那些在地震後幫助他們的人表達了感謝。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
日本政府通過拍攝感謝視頻向那些在地震後幫助他們的人表達了感謝。這裡的「表達」指的是表露或傳達情感。
補充用法：
express thanks = 表達感謝
express feelings = 表達感情
express gratitude = 表達感激

questions.text: After the new boss took office, changes in financial m_____t have been made, and the financial status of the company has therefore improved.
questions.translation: 新老闆上任後，財務管理方面做出了改變，公司的財務狀況因此有所改善。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
新老闆上任後，財務管理方面做出了改變，公司的財務狀況因此有所改善。這裡的「管理」指的是對資源或工作的組織與指導。
補充用法：
financial management = 財務管理
time management = 時間管理
project management = 項目管理

questions.text: We must find a s_____n to this problem, or we will lose the contest.
questions.translation: 我們必須找到這個問題的解決方案，否則我們將輸掉比賽。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
我們必須對這個問題找到解決方案，否則我們將輸掉比賽。這裡的「解決方案」指的是問題的解答或方法。
補充用法：
find a solution = 找到解決方案
provide a solution = 提供解決方案
solve a problem = 解決問題

questions.text: Tom and his sister are o_____zing a party for their father to celebrate Father’s Day.
questions.translation: Tom 和他的妹妹正在為他們的父親組織一個派對來慶祝父親節。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
Tom 和他的妹妹正在為他們的父親組織一個派對來慶祝父親節。這裡的「組織」指的是安排和計劃活動。
補充用法：
organize a party = 組織派對
organize an event = 組織活動
organizing committee = 組織委員會

questions.text: After the global summit, the r_____p between this nation and its neighbors has improved.
questions.translation: 在全球峰會後，這個國家與其鄰國之間的關係得到了改善。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
在全球峰會後，這個國家與其鄰國之間的關係得到了改善。這裡的「關係」指的是國家之間的外交或合作情況。
補充用法：
improve relations = 改善關係
diplomatic relationship = 外交關係
build a relationship = 建立關係

questions.text: When I did not know what to do next with my assignment, the teacher gave me some a_____ce that got me through the difficult time.
questions.translation: 當我不知道接下來該怎麼做時，老師給了我一些建議，幫助我度過了這個難關
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
當我不知道接下來該怎麼做時，老師給了我一些建議，幫助我度過了這個難關。這裡的「建議」指的是給予的意見或指導。
補充用法：
give advice = 給建議
ask for advice = 請教建議
follow advice = 跟隨建議

questions.text: Bob missed my calls, so he might send me a m_____ge later.
questions.translation: Bob 沒接到我的電話，所以他可能稍後會發送一條訊息給我。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
Bob 沒接到我的電話，所以他可能稍後會發送一條訊息給我。這裡的「訊息」指的是傳遞信息的文字內容。
補充用法：
send a message = 發送訊息
receive a message = 收到訊息
leave a message = 留下訊息

questions.text: Alan’s appearance is quite s______ar to James’s, so many people think they are twin brothers.
questions.translation: Alan 的外表和 James 很相似，因此很多人認為他們是雙胞胎兄弟。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
Alan 的外表和 James 很相似，因此很多人認為他們是雙胞胎兄弟。這裡的「相似」指的是外觀或特徵上的相同。
補充用法：
similar to = 和…相似
be similar in appearance = 外貌相似
quite similar = 非常相似

questions.text: Office workers always need to strike a b_____e between work and life.
questions.translation: 辦公室員工總是需要在工作和生活之間找到平衡。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
辦公室員工總是需要在工作和生活之間找到平衡。這裡的「平衡」指的是在兩個事物之間達到一個合適的程度或狀態。
補充用法：
strike a balance = 找到平衡
work-life balance = 工作與生活的平衡
maintain a balance = 維持平衡

questions.text: ̇Mike’s classmates were chatting loudly during the break, so he couldn’t f_____s on reading.
questions.translation: Mike 的同班同學在休息時間大聲聊天，因此他無法專心閱讀。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
Mike 的同班同學在休息時間大聲聊天，因此他無法專心閱讀。這裡的「專心」指的是集中注意力。
補充用法：
focus on = 集中注意力於
lose focus = 失去專注
maintain focus = 保持專注

questions.text: Cindy found some problems at the third s_____ge of the homework, so she had to do it again.
questions.translation: Cindy 在作業的第三個階段發現了一些問題，所以她不得不再做一遍。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
Cindy 在作業的第三個階段發現了一些問題，所以她不得不再做一次。這裡的「階段」指的是作業過程中的某一個步驟或階段。
補充用法：
in the early stages = 在初期階段
at the final stage = 在最後階段
a key stage = 關鍵階段

questions.text: Bob got a lot of v_____le experience and learned several useful lessons from his winter job.
questions.translation: Bob 從他的寒假工作中獲得了許多有價值的經驗，並學到了幾個有用的教訓。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
Bob 從他的寒假工作中獲得了許多有價值的經驗，並學到了幾個有用的教訓。這裡的「有價值的」指的是非常有用、值得學習的。
補充用法：
valuable experience = 有價值的經驗
valuable lesson = 有價值的教訓
valuable information = 有價值的資訊

questions.text: Worrying about his studies as a freshman in high school, Smith asked the teacher for m______ds to prepare for the exams.
questions.translation: 因為擔心自己作為高中的新生，Smith 向老師請教如何準備考試的方法。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
在高中的新生階段，Smith 因為擔心學業問題，請教老師如何準備考試。這裡的「方法」指的是完成某項任務的具體步驟或策略。
補充用法：
study methods = 學習方法
teaching methods = 教學方法
effective methods = 有效的方法

questions.text: By listening to the conversation between the police and the suspect, we found out that the suspect had been in c_____n with the victim.
questions.translation: 聽取警察和嫌疑人之間的對話後，我們發現嫌疑人曾與受害人有過聯繫。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
聽取警察和嫌疑人之間的對話後，我們發現嫌疑人曾與受害人有過聯繫。這裡的「聯繫」指的是交流或溝通。
補充用法：
be in communication = 與…有聯繫
maintain communication = 維持聯繫
lose communication = 失去聯繫

questions.text: This pill is highly e_____ve against stomachaches. You will feel better within half an hour after you take it.
questions.translation: 這顆藥對胃痛非常有效。你服用後會在半小時內感覺好轉。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
這顆藥對胃痛非常有效。你服用後會在半小時內感覺好轉。這裡的「有效的」指的是對某事物有治療或改善效果。
補充用法：
effective against = 對…有效
highly effective = 非常有效
effective treatment = 有效的治療

questions.text: Sara is a successful singer because she is not afraid of taking on ch_____ges.
questions.translation: Sara 成為一位成功的歌手，因為她不怕接受挑戰。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
Sara 成為一位成功的歌手，因為她不怕接受挑戰。這裡的「挑戰」指的是需要努力克服的困
難或障礙。
補充用法：
face challenges = 面對挑戰
take on challenges = 接受挑戰
overcome challenges = 克服挑戰

questions.text: Since the war broke out (爆發), international organizations show their c______ns over human rights and the safety of children.
questions.translation: 自從戰爭爆發以來，國際組織對人權和兒童安全表達了關切。
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
自從戰爭爆發以來，國際組織對人權和兒童安全表達了關切。這裡的「關切」指的是對某事的擔憂或關注。
補充用法：
express concerns = 表達關切
raise concerns = 提出關切
serious concerns = 嚴重的關切

questions.text: In order to do the study and report, the professor ______ (advice) us to interview some experts and find some relevant information from the library.
questions.translation: 為了做這項研究並撰寫報告，教授建議我們採訪一些專家並從圖書館找到一些相關資料。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
這裡需要選擇動詞 advises，表示「建議」，並且要與主語「the professor」一致。
句意說明：
這句話說明教授建議學生們採訪一些專家並從圖書館尋找相關資訊。

questions.text: Greenpeace an international _____ (organize) whose goal is to protect the environment.
questions.translation: Greenpeace是一個國際性的組織，目標是保護環境。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
句中需要填入名詞形式 organization，表示「組織」。
句意說明：
句子強調 Greenpeace 是一個國際性環保組織。

questions.text: After having practiced speaking English for a long time, Adam can now _____ (communication) confidently with others in English.
questions.translation: 經過長時間的英語口語練習後，Adam現在可以自信地與他人用英語交流。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
句中應選擇動詞 communicate，表示「交流」。
句意說明：
本句表示Adam現在能夠自信地用英語與他人交流。

questions.text: It has been proved that there is a strong ______ (relationship) between smoking and lung cancer.
questions.translation: 已經證明，吸菸與肺癌之間有著強烈的關聯。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
這裡應選擇名詞 relation，表示「關係」。
句意說明：
這句話表示研究已證明吸菸與肺癌之間有密切關聯。

questions.text: A _____ (survey) shows that sixty-five percent of adults do not get enough exercise.
questions.translation: 一項調查顯示，65%的成年人運動不足。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
根據語境，這裡應該選擇名詞 survey(調查)，作為句子的主語。
句意說明：
本句表示「一項調查顯示，大部分成年人運動不足」。

questions.text: Andy learned that smoking has a very negative _____ (effective) on his body, so he finally decided to quit.
questions.translation: Andy了解到抽煙對他的身體有非常負面的影響，所以他最終決定戒煙。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
這裡應該填入名詞 effect，表示「影響」。
句意說明：
本句說明抽煙對Andy身體的負面影響。

questions.text: During the speech, the presidential candidate promised that he would do his best to ensure people’s right to freedom of _____ (express).
questions.translation: 在演講中，總統候選人承諾他將竭盡全力保護人民的表達自由權。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
這裡應選擇名詞 expression，表示「表達」。
句意說明：
本句中講述的是候選人承諾保護人民表達自由的權利。

questions.text: Although this is just a cheap watch, it is a thing of great ______ (valuable) to me. It is a gift from my grandmother.
questions.translation: 雖然這只是一隻便宜的手錶，但它對我來說具有很大的價值。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
本句需要的是名詞形式 value，表示「價值」。
句意說明：
這句話表示即使這只是一隻便宜的手錶，對我來說它的價值非凡。

questions.text: Eddie has been very quiet recently, and it really _____ (concern) his friends.
questions.translation: Eddie最近一直很安靜，這真的讓他的朋友們很擔心。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
主詞是「it」，是第三人稱單數，因此動詞要用第三人稱單數形式 concerns。
句意說明：
本句意思是「Eddie最近很安靜，這讓他的朋友們感到擔心」。

questions.text: ̇Vera is good at math, so this quiz does not _____ (challenge) her at all.
questions.translation: Vera擅長數學，所以這份小測驗對她完全沒有挑戰性。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
句子主詞是「this quiz」，而動詞 challenge 需要保持原形，因為這裡與「does not」搭配。
句意說明：
本句意思是「這份測驗對Vera來說完全沒有挑戰性」。

questions.text: The couple kept arguing with each other, not knowing that this would not help _____ (solution) their problems.
questions.translation: 這對夫妻一直在爭吵，卻不知道這樣做不會幫助解決他們的問題。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
本句需要的是動詞形式，因此選擇 solve，表示「解決問題」。
句意說明：
本句強調爭吵並不能幫助解決問題。

questions.text: The teacher told the students that it was important to learn how to _____ (management) their time wisely.
questions.translation: 老師告訴學生們，學會如何明智地管理時間是很重要的。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
本句需要使用動詞形式 manage，來表示「有效管理時間」。
句意說明：
本句強調學會如何明智地管理時間。

questions.text: The company is now in a(n) _____ situation after the boss got into the scandal (醜聞) of giving money to the mayor.
questions.translation:
公司目前處於緊急情況，因為老闆捲入了賄賂市長的醜聞。
(A) 緊急
(B) 有效
(C) 有價值
(D) 相似
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
公司目前處於緊急情況，因為老闆捲入了賄賄市長的醜聞。

questions.text: is key when it comes to relationships. It is important to talk about things so that you can know what others are thinking.
questions.translation:
溝通對於關係至關重要，能幫助你了解別人在想什麼。
(A) 溝通
(B) 組織
(C) 挑戰
(D) 價值
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
溝通在關係中是最重要的，能幫助了解他人的想法。

questions.text: The school _____ all freshmen to understand which course they thought was the most interesting and useful.
questions.translation:
學校對所有新生進行了調查，以了解他們認為最有趣和最有用的課程。
(A) 解決
(B) 表達
(C) 調查
(D) 交流
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
學校進行了一項調查，了解新生最感興趣和認為最有用的課程。

questions.text: There are lots of things to _____ before you study abroad; for example, apply for a visa (簽證), passport, and student dormitory (宿舍).
questions.translation:
在你出國之前，有很多事情要處理；例如，申請簽證、護照和學生宿舍等。
(A) 與…相處
(B) 處理
(C) 找出
(D) 為…激動
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
出國前需要處理許多事宜，如申請簽證、護照以及宿舍等。

questions.text: Darcey is a sweet lover. _____ chocolate cake, apple pie is her favorite dessert.
questions.translation:
Darcey除了巧克力蛋糕此外蘋果派是她最喜歡的甜點。
(A) 比
(B) 與
(C) 像
(D) 此外
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
Darcey除了巧克力蛋糕外，還很喜歡蘋果派。

questions.text: When facing a challenge, my dad always tells me to find the _____ to the problem on my own rather than wait for the answer from others.
questions.translation:
面對挑戰時，爸爸總是告訴我自己找到解決方案問題的方法，而不是等待別人給答案。
(A) 效果
(B) 管理
(C) 溝通
(D) 解決方案
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
面對挑戰時，爸爸總是告訴我自己找到解決問題的方法，而不是等待他人給出答案。

questions.text: The necklace is of great _____ to Grandma. She has owned it since she was nine years old.
questions.translation:
這條項鍊對奶奶來說具有很大的價值。她從九歲起就擁有它。
(A) 表達
(B) 信息
(C) 關係
(D) 價值
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
奶奶對這條項鍊有著深厚的情感價值，因為她從九歲起就擁有它。

questions.text: The government leaders all went to the church service to show their respect to the _____ president of the country.
questions.translation:
所有政府領導人都參加了教堂服務，以表示對該國前任總統的尊敬。
(A) 前任
(B) 緊急
(C) 有效
(D) 相似
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
政府領導人參加了教堂的禮拜服務，表示對前總統的尊敬。

questions.text: The government plans to start a program to give young couples money to help care for their babies _____.
questions.translation:
政府計劃啟動一個計劃，幫助年輕夫妻在不久的將來照顧孩子。
(A) 處理
(B) 此外
(C) 相處
(D) 不久的將來
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
政府計劃在不久的將來啟動一個幫助年輕夫妻照顧孩子的計劃。

questions.text: After a few people got hurt, many customers expressed their _____ about the safety of the facilities in the amusement park.
questions.translation:
在幾個人受傷之後，許多顧客表達了他們對遊樂園設施安全的擔憂。
(A) 顧問
(B) 擔憂
(C) 階段
(D) 興奮
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
顧客在遊樂園中受傷後，表達了他們對設施安全的擔憂。

questions.text: When you are not sure which school to go to, you can turn to your parents for some _____.
questions.translation:
當你不確定選擇哪所學校時，你可以向父母請教一些建議。
(A) 管理
(B) 建議
(C) 關係
(D) 階段
questions.analysis:
句意說明：
當你不確定選擇哪所學校時，可以向父母請教。

questions.text: After many tests, Sherry finally found a _____ for improving the problems of sleep.
questions.translation:
經過許多測試，Sherry最終找到了改善睡眠問題的方法。
(A) 懲罰
(B) 管理
(C) 方法
(D) 表達
questions.analysis:

With many jobs and school courses requiring meeting deadlines, sometimes people put off doing their work, which can cause them stress and torment. There’s even a word that describes the lack of motivation to getting things done: it’s called “procrastination.” And though some people may mock others who procrastinate, it can cause profound distress and despair for people who continually put off their work.
    Psychological professionals believe that procrastination can be caused by either physical problems with the brain or mental difficulties. The physical causes of procrastination may be that the part of the brain that deals with organizing work may be damaged or does not work properly.
The mental, or psychological, problems that cause procrastination can include low self-esteem, a vague feeling that things aren’t going to turn out right, or mental depression, from which people feel sad and hopeless, making it very difficult for them to get anything done. There are also two main types of procrastinators: those who worry a lot about the work they’re not getting done, and those who are calm about their procrastination. The first type would have many negative feelings about not completing their work, and the relaxed type of procrastinators will generally not worry about the work they’re not getting done.
    Though chronic procrastination can be overwhelming, thankfully, there are some ways to modify one’s procrastination behaviors. Understanding why you procrastinate is the first step in stopping the behavior. Another helpful tool is to prioritize your tasks and pay close attention to time management. Setting goals and promising to meet these goals is also a way of avoiding procrastination and increasing work and schoolwork productivity.
    Regardless of someone’s reason for procrastinating, he or she may want to consult with a counselor to learn about what may be causing their procrastination and how to overcome it.

    由於許多工作和學校課程都需要在截止日期前完成，有時人們會延後工作，這會給他們帶來壓力和折磨。甚至有一個字來描述缺乏完成事情的動力：這就是「拖延」。儘管有些人可能會嘲笑那些拖延的人，但這可能會給那些不斷拖延工作的人帶來深深的痛苦和絕望。
    心理學專家認為拖延可能是由大腦引起的身體問題或精神障礙所造成的。造成拖延症的生理原因可能是大腦中負責組織工作的部分受損或無法正常運作。導致拖延的精神或心理問題可能包括自尊心低、一種模稜兩可的感覺，認為事情不會順利發展，或者是精神憂鬱，讓人們感到悲傷和絕望，讓他們很難完成任何事情。拖延者也有兩種主要類型：那些對自己未完成的工作非常擔心的人，以及那些對自己的拖延表現平靜的人。第一種類型會對沒有完成工作有很多負面情緒，而放鬆型的拖延者通常不會擔心他們沒有完成的工作。
    儘管長期拖延可能會讓人難以忍受，但值得慶幸的是，有一些方法可以改變一個人的拖延行為。停止拖延行為的第一步是了解其原因。另一個有用的工具是確定任務的優先順序並密切關注時間管理。設定目標並承諾實現這些目標也是避免拖延和提高工作和學業生產效率的一種方法。

There is an English proverb that says, “If you want a friend, be a friend.” Being a friend is somewhat like being a chef—you have to work at making and keeping friendships similar to the way a good chef puts a lot of effort into making a delicious recipe.
    Friendships usually begin with shared interests. Friends like to do things together that they enjoy, such as playing chess or going to movies. Once a friendship begins, however, it takes effort to keep it going through talking with and visiting friends. Strong friendships are also based upon trust. True friends know they can share their feelings and feel comfortable talking about their problems with one another. Other ingredients that make good friendships include being helpful, offering encouragement, and giving love and support.
    On the other hand, you can develop your empathy by “putting yourself in another person’s shoes,” to try to understand their feelings. This means that you don’t focus only on yourself but also take good care of your friends so that you will have a healthy relationship.
    A chef who correctly follows a recipe, mixes ingredients skillfully, and cooks carefully is rewarded with food that tastes wonderful. Similarly, people who follow the recipe for building and maintaining friendships will be rewarded with happiness and many friends during their lifetime.

If you’re shy, you may have wondered how they became so charismatic. Although some people are naturally charismatic, interpersonal skills can be developed with the right practice. Here are some tips you can use to improve your ability to communicate.
    The easiest way to communicate better is to start smiling more. We all prefer to be around happy and positive people, and by smiling, others will naturally be more responsive to your ideas. Another way to improve your interpersonal skills is to be appreciative. Everyone likes to hear that they are doing a good job, and showing your appreciation makes others want to do something nice in return.
    If you want to be able to influence others, you will need to become an active listener. We all want to be heard, so when someone pays attention to us, we are more willing to listen to them as well. Finally, you should remember the old saying that “laughter is the best medicine” when dealing with people. By joking around and showing our sense of humor, we can build closer bonds with those around us.

    在學校裡，學生通常根據他們能記住多少資訊以及他們在考試中的表現來排名。但是一旦人們進入現實世界裡，他們很快就會意識到他們需要一套不同的工具才能在工作和個人生活中取得成功。
    社交能力可以定義為我們用來與他人溝通的技能。如果你曾經欽佩過一位有影響力的演講者，你可能會對他們的社交能力印象深刻。如果你很害羞，你可能想知道他們是如何變得如此有魅力的。儘管有些人天生就有魅力，但透過正確的練習可以培養社交能力。你可以使用以下一些技巧來提高溝通能力。

    如果你希望能夠影響他人，你需要成為一名主動的傾聽者。我們都希望有個人能夠聆聽，所以當有人關注我們時，我們也更願意傾聽他們的內心想法。最後，在與人來往時，你應該記住一句老話：「笑是最好的良藥」。透過開玩笑和表現出幽默感，我們可以與周圍的人建立更緊密的聯繫。

Life moves faster now than it ever has before. Everyone’s trying to do at least three different things at the same time, and then there’s social media to keep up with. It can be tough to be a student in this environment––it might even be impossible without good time management skills. These skills will help you organize your time and get the most from your day. That means less stress, more time for the things you enjoy, and probably better grades.
    When managing your time, the first thing you’ll need to do is decide what really matters to you. You might want to hang out with friends, play for the school basketball team, and spend hours playing video games, but you probably can’t do it all. Decide what’s important, make time for it, and move the rest to the side.
    Next up, organize your time. Create a schedule and split up the time in your day. If it helps, use colored blocks to break up time for study, hobbies, and relaxation, and make sure you keep these things separate. If you’re studying, turn off your social media, and if you’re spending time with friends, don’t even think about school.
    Finally, remember to look after your physical and mental health. When you’re organizing a crowded schedule, it’s easy to think that cutting back on sleep or leisure time is a good idea. If you sleep less, you can work more, right? Well, probably not. The more tired you feel, the less effectively you’ll work, and you’re also more likely to feel sad or stressed. So, stay organized, stay rested, and stay happy!

    現在的生活節奏比以往任何時候都快。每個人都試圖同時做至少三件不同的事情，然後也要跟上社交媒體上的最新動態。在這種環境下做一名學生可能會很困難—如果沒有良好的時間管理技能，這甚至是不可能的。這些技能將幫助你安排時間並充分利用每一天。這意味著更少的壓力，更多的時間去做你喜歡的事情，並且可能會得到更好的成績。

Experts have defined comfort zone as a mental state in which you have few risks, few dangers, and few challenges. If you’re wondering what’s so bad about that, these things make it almost impossible for you to develop and achieve your goals. To do that, you’ll have to leave the comfort zone and move to the growth zone.
    In this zone, you won’t be able to fully relax, and life might not be all that easy. It’ll be worth it, though, because it’s only here that you can become the person you’ve always wanted to be. In the growth zone, you can think about a bigger future and push yourself to achieve more.
    It’s clear that we need to leave the comfort zone behind if we want to live our best lives, but many of us struggle to do that. It’s not just laziness holding us back; psychologists think many of us simply don’t believe we’re able to achieve our goals. A large number don’t even believe they deserve success.
    Getting past these mental blocks is difficult, especially if we’ve spent a long time living in our comfort zone. But, if you’re determined to pursue your dreams, focus on the positives instead of your doubts. And if moving forward will require hard work, see it as an opportunity rather than a burden.
    Finally, what if you’re ready for a new challenge but don’t know where to start? The experts say you should make new friends, try a new hobby, watch a new YouTube channel—do anything you can to break your routine. The more new ideas you expose yourself to, the more you’ll be able to see new, exciting opportunities ahead of you.

Emotional intelligence is the ability to understand your emotions and those of other people. Developing your “E.I.” or “E.Q.” can help you in many situations. Emotional intelligence operates on two main levels.
    On the personal level, you can work on managing your own emotions to lead a more productive life. For example, if you have to make a speech or take an exam, you may suffer from anxiety. This may paralyze you, stress you out, or even make you sick, thereby lowering your performance. However, thinking about the emotion can help.
    “I am rightly anxious because I have something important to achieve. I will focus on how to reach my goal rather than my worry. In this way, negative stress can be converted into positive stress so that in the end I will be able to say, ‘Pass or fail, I did my best.’” In this situation, anxiety is transformed into helpful energy.
    On the interpersonal level, you can develop your empathy by “putting yourself in another person’s shoes,” to try to understand their feelings. For example, you feel an old aunt you haven’t seen for twenty years is being cold and uncaring because she doesn’t invite you to visit her. You are angry and want to stop contacting her altogether.
    But then you remember that when you used to visit she would always prepare a tasty dinner. Nowadays, she has a bad back and couldn’t possibly manage preparing such a meal. She would feel ashamed if you visited her. Having understood her feelings, you read the situation differently. Anger becomes sympathy, and you continue the relationship by calling her regularly.
    These examples show that developing emotional intelligence can improve the quality of your own and other people’s lives. It can help you achieve your own goals and it can also make you better at handling working and family relationships.

    情緒智商(情商)是理解自己和他人情緒的能力。發展你的「情商」可以在很多情況下幫助你。情商主要在兩個層面上發揮作用。
    在個人層面上，你可以努力管理自己的情緒，以過更富有成效的生活。例如，如果你必須發表演講或參加考試，你可能會感到焦慮。這可能會讓你有無力感，給你壓力，甚至讓你生病，進而降低你的表現。然而，思考這種情緒會有所幫助。
    「我確實感到焦慮，因為我有重要的事要達成。我會專注於如何實現我的目標，而不是擔心。這樣，負面壓力就可以被轉化為正面壓力，最後我就能說，『成功或失敗，我都盡力了。』」在這種情況下，焦慮被轉化為有益的能量。
    在人際交往方面，你可以通過「設身處地為他人著想」來培養同理心，嘗試理解他們的感受。例如，你覺得一位二十年未見的老阿姨冷漠無情，因為她不邀請你去拜訪她。你很生氣，想完全停止與她聯繫。
    但你會記得，當你之前去拜訪她時，她總是會準備一頓美味的晚餐。現今，她的背不好，不可能準備這樣的飯菜。如果你去看她，她會感到羞恥。理解了她的感受後，你對情況的解讀就不同了。憤怒變成了同情，你可以透過定期打電話給她來維持關係。
    這些例子表示發展情商可以提高你自己和他人的生活品質。它可以幫助你實現自己的目標，還可以讓你把工作和家庭關係處理得更好。

All of us are conscious about how we look. We often focus our attention on our faults much more than other people do. This can lead to feelings of embarrassment or inferiority because we feel our physical faults stand out. Looking at particular physical attributes, we concentrate time and energy on changing them. This type of devotion to appearance can sometimes be a good thing. However, it can also be detrimental if it begins to consume us.
    Rather than worrying so much about physical appearance, it is more important to focus on the good things about ourselves. Being a friendly, honest, and caring person is more important than how we look. People who only care to befriend us because of how we look are actually just superficial people themselves. Those who dig deeper and try to discover the things that make us unique human beings are the ones we should strive to have as friends. True friends are the ones who like us for who we are, and they have the ability to earn our friendship because their attitude shows in how they treat us.
    It is essential to be yourself and find happiness with who you are rather than just what you look like. Let your inner beauty shine rather than wasting all of your time changing your looks or trying to keep up with the latest trends. If you do this, you will discover true, lasting friendships with those around you because they will not be false friends; they will be people who love you for who you are. In a world that is teeming with superficiality, who could ask for more?

    我們所有人都在意自己的外表。我們常常比其他人更關注自己的錯誤。這可能會導致尷尬或自卑的感覺，因為我們覺得自己的身體缺陷很突兀。針對特定的身體特徵，我們會集中時間和精力來改變它們。這種對外表的追求有時是一件好事。然而，如果它開始吞噬我們，也可能是有害的。
    與其過度擔心外表，更重要的是關注自己的優點。做一個友善、誠實、體貼的人比我們的外表更重要。那些只是因為我們的外表而想要與我們交朋友的人，實際上，他們本身就是膚淺的人。那些會深入挖掘並試圖發現讓我們成為人類獨特之處的人，才是我們應該努力結交的朋友，真正的朋友是那些喜歡我們本來樣子的人，他們有能力贏得我們的友誼，因為他們的態度表現在他們對待我們的方式上。

questions.answer: My parents had lived in Hsinchu County before they moved to Taitung County.
questions.translation: 我的父母在搬到台東縣之前，曾經住在新竹縣。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
比較兩個時間點。2010–2015 住在新竹，2015 搬到台東，所以要用 had lived 表示較早的動作。

questions.text: Fred got to the train station at 2 p.m. The train left the station at 1 p.m. (用S + had + p.p.改寫) ___________________________________________________________________
questions.answer: When Fred got to the train station, the train had left the station.
questions.translation: 當 Fred 到車站時，火車已經離開了。
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
比較時間先後。火車 1 點就開走 → Fred 2 點才到，因此火車「已經開走」要用 
had left。

questions.text: _____________ _____________ _____________ your studies, there are also other interesting things for you to experience at school, such as club activities.
questions.analysis:

in addition to + 名詞 = 除…之外，是固定片語，用來補充學業之外的活動。

Samuel has to ______ ______ ______ ______ as soon as possible, or it will get even worse.

questions.answer: As you have trouble managing your time, I advise you to organize your schedule first.
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：

questions.answer: As Roger was making his plans for the weekend, he thought of a project he had to work on.
questions.analysis:

questions.suggestedAnswer: As Roger was making his plans for the weekend, he thought of a project he had to work on.
questions.chineseText: 當Roger在安排他的周末計畫時，他想到他還有一個企劃要做。

questions.answer: Before the boss asked for the solution, Oliver had dealt with this urgent situation.
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
Before + 過去式表示「在老闆要求解決方法之前」，Oliver 已經處理好緊急狀況，因此用過去完成式 had dealt with。
questions.suggestedAnswer: Before the boss asked for the solution, Oliver had dealt with this urgent situation.
questions.chineseText: 在老闆要求解決方法之前，Oliver 就已經處理好這個緊急狀況了。

questions.answer: Charlie had followed his parents’ advice and decided to major in Chinese by the end of last week.
questions.analysis:
解題關鍵：
by the end of last week + 過去完成式表示「在上週結束前 Charlie 已經遵從父母建議做出決定」。
questions.suggestedAnswer: Charlie had followed his parents’ advice and decided to major in Chinese by the end of last week.
questions.chineseText: 上週結束前，Charlie已經遵從父母的建議而決定主修中文。

questions.answer: I decided to be a writer because my mother had had a great effect/influence on me in my childhood.

questions.suggestedAnswer: I decided to be a writer because my mother had had a great effect/influence on me in my childhood.
questions.chineseText: 我決定成為一個作家，因為我媽媽在我童年時期帶給我很大的影響。

questions.answer: Andrew had finished the winter homework before the new semester started.

questions.answer: I had learned some very useful ways to complete my homework more effectively in high school.

questions.answer: Every small step you take brings you closer to the top.

questions.answer: The school bell had rung before the students left the classroom.

questions.chineseText: 學生離開教室前，學校鐘聲就已經響了。

questions.answer: When Evelyn got home, her younger sister had already fallen asleep.
questions.analysis:

過去完成式表示妹妹在 Evelyn 回家之前就已經睡著。

questions.chineseText: 在Evelyn回到家的時候，妹妹已經睡著了。

questions.answer: (1)All of us like to travel overseas.　(2)We usually have trouble with the language when we are abroad.

like to travel = 喜歡旅遊，是常見動詞搭配。
(2)	解題關鍵：
have trouble with = 在…方面遇到困難，是固定片語；when we are abroad 描述時間背景。

questions.answer: (1)Stephanie left the house at seven in the morning.　(2)When she got to the company at nine in the morning, the meeting had started.
questions.analysis:
(1)	解題關鍵：
一般過去式 left 描述過去的動作。
(2)	解題關鍵：
過去完成式 had started 用於描述「當她到公司時，會議已經開始」，先後動作要清楚區分。
questions.suggestedAnswer: (1)Stephanie left the house at seven in the morning.　(2)When she got to the company at nine in the morning, the meeting had started.
questions.chineseText: (1)	Stephanie早上7點離開家裡。

questions.answer: (1)Mia and Susan got along with each other well in high school five years ago.　(2)In addition to the time at school, they had played in a band together before they graduated.
questions.analysis:
(1)	解題關鍵：
get along with each other = 彼此相處融洽，是固定片語，用一般過去式描述五年前高中時的情況。
(2)	解題關鍵：
in addition to + 名詞 = 除…之外，表示補充資訊；had played 表示在畢業前已經做過的動作，用過去完成式。
questions.suggestedAnswer: (1)Mia and Susan got along with each other well in high school five years ago.　(2)In addition to the time at school, they had played in a band together before they graduated.
questions.chineseText: (1)	Mia和Susan在五年前的高中期間一直彼此相處融洽。

questions.answer: (1)Did you remember to register for the history course?　(2)Yes. I had done it a week before the deadline.
questions.analysis:
(1)	解題關鍵：
過去完成式 (had + p.p.) 用於描述在另一過去時間點(截止日前一週)之前已經完成的動作。
(2)	解題關鍵：
Did you remember to… 是用來詢問對方是否記得做某事的自然用法。
questions.suggestedAnswer: (1)Did you remember to register for the history course?　(2)Yes. I had done it a week before the deadline.
questions.chineseText: (1)	你有記得去登記歷史課嗎？

questions.answer: (1)Now, we still have trouble traveling to other countries because of COVID-19.　(2)As the situation gets better, we will be able to go abroad in the near future.
questions.analysis:
(1)	解題關鍵：
still have trouble + V-ing = 仍然在…方面有困難，描述現在的狀況。
(2)	解題關鍵：
in the near future = 在不久的將來，描述未來即將發生的事情，搭配 will able to 表示能力或可能性。
questions.suggestedAnswer: (1)Now, we still have trouble traveling to other countries because of COVID-19.　(2)As the situation gets better, we will be able to go abroad in the near future.
questions.chineseText: (1)	現在，因為COVID-19，去其他國家旅遊對我們來說還是有困難。

questions.topicDescription:
簡函寫作
提示：當來到一個新環境中，我們總是感到不安也可能遭遇許多困難。請以學長姐的身份寫一封信分享你的經驗與建議給即將來到高中就讀的新生們，第一段請說明你曾在新環境中遭遇的困難與挑戰為何，第二段則分享你的建議說明你如何克服。
請注意：信末請用Ray或Helen署名，不得使用自己的真實姓名。
questions.analysis:
文章結構：作文需分兩段，第一段描述困難與挑戰，第二段提供解決建議或經驗分享。清楚分段讓讀者一目了然。
內容重點：
第一段要寫出「我曾經在新環境中遇到哪些困難」並用具體例子說明(例如害羞、交新朋友困難、適應新環境的挑戰)。
第二段要寫「我如何克服」或「給新生的建議」，可包含具體做法或策略(例如主動與同學聊天、記住名字、了解興趣)
